# [TASK] Add custom avatar upload workflow and live preview on Profile screen

## Task
Implement a custom profile photo uploader in the React frontend (`frontend/filmpire`) on the User Profile screen, enabling users to upload personalized avatars directly to the backend media-service.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] File selector unit allows image uploading (JPG/PNG, size validation < 5MB) on the Profile screen
- [x] API client calls `POST /api/v1/media/upload` with `entityType=USER` and `mediaType=AVATAR`
- [x] Displayed user avatar across the navigation bar and profile page reflects the uploaded thumbnail URL from MongoDB/MinIO
- [x] Unit/DOM tests cover file selection, validation error states, and preview rendering

## Estimate
Hours: 10

## Notes
• Verified via Jest tests in Profile.test.jsx and NavBar.test.jsx (100% passing, zero ESLint warnings).
• Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §3.8.
